page.title: Development Journal
page.description: A record of product architecture, interface decisions, implementation milestones, and the next steps shaping this project.

editorial-system.title: Editorial System Milestone
editorial-system.summary: This milestone established a more structured editorial system for Nine2Fire, defining how long-form content, practical tools and public learning can work together within one product.

product-architecture.title: Product Architecture Milestone
product-architecture.summary: This milestone moved deckLog beyond interface concepts by defining its product vocabulary, domain boundaries and operational structure.

fleet-explorer.title: Fleet Explorer
fleet-explorer.summary: The first fleet overview uses reusable cards, localized copy and a clearer information structure for browsing boats and their operational status.
